column1: # TOCFL vocabulary: 華語八千詞表 (國家華語測驗推動工作委員會 SC-TOP, file 華語八千詞表20240923.xlsx).
#   160/234/347/485/1173/2342/2776 per level; Level 6 (精通級) has no list of its own.
# Format: level<TAB>word. Levels: 1 準備級一級 (Novice 1), 2 準備級二級 (Novice 2), 3 入門級 (Level 1),
#   4 基礎級 (Level 2), 5 進階級 (Level 3), 6 高階級 (Level 4), 7 流利級 (Level 5).
# Entries are expanded: variants after '/' are words of their own (你/妳, 台灣/臺灣, 爸爸/爸), an optional
#   part in parentheses gives both forms (車(子): 車, 車子), zhuyin reading notes are dropped. Four
#   abbreviated entries are written out (古蹟/跡: 古蹟, 古跡). Each word once, at its lowest level.
# Added Simplified forms that character-level T→S folding misses: 着 for 著 read zhe/zháo/zhuó (著, 接著,
#   著急; not 著名), and 反复, 答复, 借口, 复苏.
